observation.command: echo "=== apache error log full relevant ==="; grep -c 'Odd number' /var/log/apache2/error.log; echo "=== HTTP on root ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost/qisutu/; echo "=== CSRF/session cookie set ==="; grep -i QISUTU_SESSION /tmp/cj2.txt; echo "=== admin area ==="; curl -s -b cj2.txt -o /tmp/admin.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl?Step=AdminSystemSettings" ; grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/admin.html
